ar.title: صينية الدجاج المحمَر

steps.n1: يخلط جيدا الدقيق بالكمون والكسبرة والملح والفلفل.
steps.n2: تقطَع الدجاجة أرباعا وتتبل في الخليط.
steps.n3: تحمر في الزيت حتى يصير لونها بنيا وترفع على مناديل ورقية.
steps.n4: تدهن صينية بالزيت وترص فيها اللحوم أو الدجاج، وتغطى وتدخل الفرن.

en.title: Baked Pan-Seared Chicken
en.intro: Baked casserole dishes (sanyia) are weeknight staples in Egyptian homes, combining meat, vegetables, and sauce in one dish.

steps.n1: Mix the flour well with the cumin, coriander, salt and pepper.
steps.n2: Quarter the chicken and coat it in the mixture.
steps.n3: Brown in oil until golden, then drain on paper towels.
steps.n4: Oil a tray, arrange the chicken in it, cover, and bake.

legacySteps: Mix the flour well with the cumin, coriander, salt and pepper.
Quarter the chicken and coat it in the mixture.
Brown in oil until golden, then drain on paper towels.
Oil a tray, arrange the chicken in it, cover, and bake.
